caption: Aztec dancers in feathered headdresses lead a procession honouring Dolores Huerta.
London, UK People take part in a march calling for a global pause on the training of the most powerful artificial general intelligence systems, organised by PauseAI UK.
Kabul, Afghanistan A child sits on a donkey-drawn cart while collecting recyclable materials.
Paris, France Protesters and police clash during a march against the high cost of living.
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia A participant at the Ethnosport cultural festival, which brings together traditional sports, games and cultural values from different regions of the world.
Kyiv, Ukraine Newlyweds Oksana and Dmytro hold their Russian passports at their wedding. They both volunteered to defend Ukraine.
Johannesburg, South Africa An activist against gender-based violence reacts during a march organised by Women For Change to mark the nationwide Women’s Shutdown 2026.
Rongcheng, China Swans swim in the waters of Ailun Bay in wintry weather.
Tupanciretã, Brazil A drone image shows a home destroyed by a storm.
Gaza City, Gaza Palestinians inspect a vehicle transporting food aid after it was hit by an airstrike. The vehicle belonged to the Human Appeal charity.
Las Vegas, US McLaren driver Lando Norris of Britain drives during the third practice session at the Formula One Las Vegas Grand Prix.
Antalya, Turkey Darragh O’Brien, the Irish climate minister, and Wopke Hoekstra, the European commissioner for climate, walk to their office after a meeting at Cop31.
New York, US Fighters wearing steel armour and using blunt medieval-style weapons compete in full-contact bouts during the Armored League world championship.
Cornwall, UK The Helios art installation at the Eden Project. The 7-metre (23ft) orb created by Luke Jerram has illuminated the Mediterranean biome since Friday night.
Bakersfield, US Aztec dancers lead a procession before the interfaith memorial service honouring the civil rights and labour activist Dolores Huerta in California.
London, UK A woman walks below Peace Doves, an installation by artist Peter Walker, suspended inside the Painted Hall at the Old Royal Naval College in Greenwich.
Trump touches Xi Jinping's back as world leaders pose together wearing scarves at APEC.

Kyiv, Ukraine A man walks in pouring rain past a building heavily damaged by a Russian missile attack. Vladimir Putin has said Russia’s response to the bombing of the Kerch bridge to Crimea would be ‘painful’ , after Ukraine attacked the strategic connection for the third time this week. The warning was delivered at a press conference after Putin met Donald Trump and Xi Jinping in China.

Kerch strait, Crimea A satellite photograph shows the damaged Crimea Bridge over the Kerch strait. Shortly after midnight on Tuesday, Ukraine’s military blew up the central span of the Kerch road bridge in a complex air raid that involved Ruta cruise missiles made by a Dutch company as well as several Ukrainian cruise missiles and drones.

Shenzhen, China From left: Anwar Ibrahim of Malaysia, Xi Jinping of China, Mark Carney of Canada, Donald Trump of the US, Anthony Albanese of Australia, and Lee Jae Myung of South Korea pose for a group photograph during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Trump was later accused of falling asleep during a speech by the Chinese president at the summit.

Nuseirat, Gaza A girl carries cats in a transport cage as Palestinians evacuate their homes and tent shelters after an Israeli army order to leave amid a military operation. The Israeli military crossed into Hamas-controlled central Gaza this week in its first ground operation across the ‘yellow line’ boundary since a fragile ceasefire was agreed last October, forcing dozens of displaced Palestinians to flee their tents.

Deir al-Balah, Gaza An injured child is treated at the al-Aqsa hospital after an Israeli military strike in Deir al-Balah. Israeli strikes have continued since the October 2025 ceasefire. Gaza’s health authorities say at least 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since it came into effect.

Umm al-Khair, West Bank Children sit on a couch in the Bedouin village of Umm al-Khair, with the Israeli settlement of Carmel in the background. Since the 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attacks on Israel, there has been a surge of Israeli settlement expansion, ethnic cleansing and violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank.

Al-Dayrat, West Bank An Israeli soldier secures an area while military forces use bulldozers to demolish Palestinian family homes reportedly built without Israeli permits. There has been a sharp ​rise in attacks by Israeli settlers on Palestinians in the West Bank , territory Israel captured in the 1967 six-day war. UN bodies and most ​countries deem the settlements illegal, which Israel disputes.

Bnei Brak, Israel Ultra-Orthodox Jewish protesters react as a stun grenade explodes while Israeli security forces disperse them during a protest against compulsory military service in which they blocked a highway.
Nantes, France A protester protects himself from a water cannon with a traffic sign during nationwide public sector strikes and demonstrations over the rising cost of living.

New York City, US A woman and child rest on the floor of John F Kennedy international airport. Donald Trump’s administration blamed the travel chaos stemming from last week’s four-hour nationwide flight stoppage on prior presidents as well as a lack of congressional funding – though a Democratic senator argued that the Trump administration had not properly invested all of the funds it had already been given to implement needed air travel infrastructure upgrades.

Antalya, Turkey Climate campaigners carry an installation depicting the Statue of Liberty during a march to mark the opening of the People’s Climate Summit at Cop31. African negotiators accused rich countries of undermining the credibility of Cop by failing to provide needed cash while civil society activists called Antalya 2026 the ‘ worst Cop ever ’.

New York City, US A woman walks by billboards advertising the latest installment of the action-adventure video game Grand Theft Auto VI . GTA fans around the world pulled all-nighters, skipped work and school, and attended overnight launch parties to vicariously embark on police chases and coordinate robberies.

Madrid, Spain People wait at a bus stop as Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, is displayed on an electoral campaign video. Spaniards head to the polls on 29 November to vote in the country’s sixth general election in 11 years. The snap election could end eight years of socialist-led rule and bring a far-right party into government for the first time since Spain’s return to democracy after the death of Gen Franco.
Mindelo, Cape Verde A voter searches for her name on an electoral roll at a polling station during Cape Verde’s presidential election.

Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh A Rohingya refugee looks through a fence as people gather to watch the live announcement of the international court of justice verdict in the case accusing Myanmar of committing genocide against the minority Rohingya population. The world’s highest court ruled that Myanmar had committed genocide against its Rohingya minority during a 2017 military campaign, in a historic and unprecedented decision.
Gazipur, Bangladesh A woman crosses a road after a clash between the police and garment workers protesting for higher wages.
Port-au-Prince, Haiti A woman is given first aid after being teargassed by police as people marched in support of soldiers from El Salvador deployed to confront armed gangs.
Kibera, Kenya Lawrence Akai, 17, is smeared with flour before undergoing the public Imbalu ritual.

Blackpool, England Ballroom dancers Olivia-Rose Owen and Gleb Tkachenko rehearse before competing in the amateur under-21 Latin championship at the 51st British National Dance Championships in the Empress Ballroom of the Winter Gardens.

Kyiv, Ukraine Kyiv is in near total darkness during a power outage after massive ballistic missile attacks on the country. China, Russia and the US said they had agreed a peace statement after an unprecedented trilateral summit, but the declaration made no mention of the wars in Ukraine and Iran caused by two of the participants.
Masked protesters throw a large road sign into the air during a demonstration in Rome.

Bologna, Italy A scuffle takes place between law enforcement and students protesting against the cost of living in Vicolo Santa Lucia, near the headquarters of Confindustria, the General Confederation of Italian Industry.
Madrid, Spain Students attend a demonstration, demanding better conditions for education and lower living costs, and to oppose fascism.
London, UK Students demonstrate as the police set up a cordon at Whitehall for the International Youth Strike.
London, UK The UK Independence party leader, Nick Tenconi, tears up a Palestine flag during an anti-migrant protest on Whitehall.
Landes coast, France Miro G, a Malta-flagged cargo ship, ran aground overnight, prompting the evacuation of part of its crew by helicopter in Lit-et-Mixe.
Port Stanley, Falkland Islands A gentoo penguin in the dunes at Yorke Bay.

Rome, Italy Masked demonstrators throw a road sign toward riot police officers deployed outside the ministry of education as students attend a protest as part of the International Youth Day of Action.

Brussels, Belgium The European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen, the British prime minister, Andy Burnham, and the European Council president, António Costa, join hands at the end of a press conference during the second EU-UK summit.
London, UK Robert De Niro at the BBC’s Broadcasting House promoting his new movie Focker-in-Law.
Bnei Brak, Israel Ultra-Orthodox Jewish protesters react to a stun-grenade explosion as security forces try to disperse them during a protest against compulsory military service.
Melbourne, Australia Volunteers carry the Lost Petition, a long list of names of people killed by domestic violence, during Respect Victoria’s 18th annual walk against family violence.
Gwangju, South Korea People walk at Mount Mudeungsan national park after the first snowfall of the season.
Nanjing, China The 11th World Intelligent Manufacturing expo kicks off in Nanjing. It has drawn more than 600 Chinese and foreign exhibitors.

Salem, West Bank Women mourn as men carry the body of Wissam Ghassan Ishtayeh, a Palestinian man killed by Israeli forces during a military raid in the village of Salem in July 2025 and whose body was released to his family in November.
Pijijiapan, Mexico Migrants from several Central American countries walk in a caravan towards the US border.
New York City, US Gamers across the world had their first taste of Grand Theft Auto VI on Thursday, diving into one of the most hotly anticipated launches ever after a wave of midnight releases.
Las Vegas, US Elvis Presley impersonators stand in the paddock before practice sessions for the Formula One Las Vegas Grand Prix.
Rome, Italy Demonstrators march past the Colosseum during a general strike over rising living costs and military spending.
Milan, Italy A student protest coincides with a general strike expected to affect transport, schools and hospitals, with the CGIL trade union describing the protests as a ‘call for change’.

Cincinnati, US Fiona the hippopotamus has died after attempts to remove a woolly hat she had accidentally swallowed failed. The nine-year-old Nile hippo, beloved for her antics on social media, ingested the knitted cap last week and began to lose her appetite.
